independence.v3_requirement: §6.4: the noise set is independent of the main campaign and of the Headroom screening

decision_independence.why: The Headroom outcome is computed from A0 calibration data and frozen before any noise run. Selecting the noise groups from the resulting paired set cannot feed back into that decision.

population_independence.why: A paired-only draw is conditional on Headroom passing at both conditions, so sigma_run describes the paired population and not all 20 groups.
population_independence.consequence: 2 group(s) (g09, g18) are never sampled for noise and have no run-to-run variance estimate.

independence.verdict: Drawing from the 18 paired groups changes the reading of §6.4 from population independence to decision independence. That is defensible for F because `tied` is applied to the same paired population, but it is a change and must be written into v4 rather than described as an unchanged 30-run design.

selection_rule.why_not_random: A frozen hash permutation is reproducible without storing random state and cannot be steered after seeing a measurement.
selection_rule.allocation_rationale: Proportional to the paired strata (7/8/3) with the smallest stratum rounded up to 1 so no stratum is unrepresented.
selection_rule.design: 5 groups x 2 conditions x R=3 = 30 runs

alternative_if_population_independence_i.cost: The FLAT allocation would sample a group that may fail Headroom at C1, so its sigma_run would partly describe a cell that is not analysed. Same 30 runs either way.

selection_rule.frozen_by: must be written into G0 with the salt and the allocation

variance_estimation.frozen_rule: ONE rule: sigma_run is the pooled within-cell standard deviation of per-run Sigma(E-C) over the 10 sampled cells (5 groups x 2 conditions), with equal weight per cell and df = 10 x (3 - 1) = 20. sigma_delta = sqrt(2) sigma_run, tied = 2 sqrt(2) sigma_run. No other estimator is permitted for this campaign.
variance_estimation.assumption: COMMON within-cell variance across strata and conditions (homoscedasticity).
justification: Every sampled cell has the same R = 3, so the pooled estimator is balanced rather than weighted by unequal cell counts.

The design needs ONE absolute `tied` threshold applied uniformly to the paired population; per-stratum thresholds would change what counts as tied depending on which stratum a cell fell into, and no protocol section defines that.
Per-stratum estimates would rest on 4 cells (df 4) each, which is too unstable to freeze as a threshold.
variance_estimation.sigma_run: pooled within-cell SD, equal weight per cell, over 10 cells with R=3
variance_estimation.weights: equal per cell. Because the draw is stratified with a fixed allocation, the cell weights are NOT proportional to the population stratum shares: FLAT supplies 2 of 10 cells (20%) while being 3 of 18 groups (16.7%). The pooled value is therefore a design-based summary of the sampled cells, not a population-weighted variance.

stratified_outputs.status: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY. The pooled rule stands regardless of the ratio. Switching to per-stratum thresholds after seeing this diagnostic would be an S9 violation, so any such switch would require a fresh protocol amendment before the run.

variance_estimation.sigma_delta: sqrt(2) * sigma_run under independent equal variance
variance_estimation.interaction: no tied classification: it would need the within-group correlation of the two condition deltas, which is unmeasured
variance_estimation.no_post_run_change: This block is frozen at G0. The estimator, the df and the diagnostic obligations may not be revised once the noise runs exist.

v4_clause_changes: §6.4: replace 'independent of the Headroom screening' with 'independent of the Headroom decision procedure, conditioned on its outcome, and drawn by the G0-frozen deterministic rule below'.
§6.4: state that sigma_run estimates the paired population and that groups failing Headroom at either condition are not sampled.
§6.4: require stratum-specific sigma_run to be reported alongside the pooled value, because the draw is stratified and not a simple random sample of the 20 groups.
§6.4: keep the 30-run budget and the A0-only design unchanged; only the sampling frame and the reporting obligations change.
